## Activity

During March 2019, East City Eye Clinic completed 218 captures. This records the imaging activity undertaken at the site during the month. The capture total provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes reported below.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 2 were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 0.9 per cent. The result is recorded for monitoring of image quality and for consideration alongside the grading outcomes. Staff raised no new equipment faults during the month.

## Grading

A total of 32 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 7. This provides the reported measure of the time between capture and completion of grading for the month. The activity, image quality and grading figures should be considered together when reviewing operations at East City Eye Clinic.
